DIAGNOSIS READY: Pemphigus Foliaceus

The biopsy showing acantholysis with intercellular IgG and C3 deposition confirms an autoimmune blistering disease affecting the upper epidermis, which explains your forearm blisters and mucosal ulcers. Given the lack of scarring and the specific immunofluorescence pattern, this is consistent with Pemphigus Foliaceus.
